title: Stage 2: The Reducer
summary: Every change to the board as a typed action handled by one pure, immutable reducer.

steps.title: Actions
body: The UI never edits the board directly. It **dispatches actions**, and one reducer decides the next state:
Why this design pays off: every change is a plain, loggable object; the reducer is the one place to read to understand behaviour; and stage 4's undo/redo will wrap it without touching it.

The rule that matters most for React: when an action changes **nothing** (unknown id, same value, invalid title) return the **same** board object, so nothing re-renders and undo history is not polluted.

code: type T = { id: string; done: boolean };
const tasks: T[] = [{ id: "a", done: false }, { id: "b", done: false }];
const next = tasks.map(t => (t.id === "b" ? { ...t, done: true } : t));
console.log(next === tasks, next[0] === tasks[0], next[1] === tasks[1], tasks[1].done);
steps.explain: A new array, the untouched task reused, the changed task replaced, the original left alone: the shape of every reducer update.

steps.prompt: Complete the case so it returns the same board when the task is already in that status.

steps.title: boardReducer
prompt: the `Action` union above, an `assertNever` helper, and `boardReducer(board: Board, action: Action): Board`:
- `add`: append the task; if a task with that id exists, return the same board
- `rename`: trim the title; an empty or over-100-character title, an unknown id, or an unchanged title returns the same board
- `move` / `setPriority`: change that field; unknown id or same value returns the same board
- `remove`: remove by id; unknown id returns the same board
- `clearDone`: remove all `"done"` tasks; if there are none, return the same board
Never mutate: the tests freeze the board. Unchanged tasks must stay the **same objects**.

function boardReducer(board: Board, action: Action): Board {
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.title === title ? t : { ...t, title }));
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.status === action.status ? t : { ...t, status: action.status }));
return updateTask(board, action.id, t => (t.priority === action.priority ? t : { ...t, priority: action.priority }));
template: {{CODE}}
const dojoMk = (id: string, title: string, extra: Partial<Task> = {}): Task => ({ id, title, status: "todo", priority: "medium", tags: [], createdAt: Number(id.slice(1)), ...extra });
Dojo.eq("createTask still works", "todo", (createTask({ title: "x" }, "t9", 9) as any).value?.status);
const dojoB0: Board = Object.freeze({ tasks: Object.freeze([Object.freeze(dojoMk("t1", "Write")), Object.freeze(dojoMk("t2", "Test"))]) as Task[] });
try {
const b1 = boardReducer(dojoB0, { type: "add", task: dojoMk("t3", "Ship") });
Dojo.eq("add", ["t1", "t2", "t3"], b1.tasks.map(t => t.id));
Dojo.check("add duplicate id returns same board", boardReducer(b1, { type: "add", task: dojoMk("t3", "Again") }) === b1, "expected the same board object");
const b2 = boardReducer(b1, { type: "move", id: "t1", status: "doing" });
Dojo.eq("move", "doing", b2.tasks[0].status);
Dojo.check("move keeps other task objects", b2.tasks[1] === b1.tasks[1], "unchanged tasks should be the same objects");
Dojo.eq("rename trims", "Write docs", boardReducer(b2, { type: "rename", id: "t1", title: "  Write docs " }).tasks[0].title);
Dojo.check("rename to empty returns same board", boardReducer(b2, { type: "rename", id: "t1", title: "  " }) === b2, "expected the same board object");
Dojo.eq("setPriority", "high", boardReducer(b2, { type: "setPriority", id: "t2", priority: "high" }).tasks[1].priority);
Dojo.check("no-op setPriority returns same board", boardReducer(b2, { type: "setPriority", id: "t2", priority: "medium" }) === b2, "expected the same board object");
Dojo.check("move unknown id returns same board", boardReducer(b2, { type: "move", id: "nope", status: "done" }) === b2, "expected the same board object");
Dojo.eq("remove", ["t1", "t3"], boardReducer(b2, { type: "remove", id: "t2" }).tasks.map(t => t.id));
const b3 = boardReducer(boardReducer(b2, { type: "move", id: "t2", status: "done" }), { type: "move", id: "t3", status: "done" });
Dojo.eq("clearDone", ["t1"], boardReducer(b3, { type: "clearDone" }).tasks.map(t => t.id));
Dojo.check("clearDone with nothing done returns same board", boardReducer(dojoB0, { type: "clearDone" }) === dojoB0, "expected the same board object");
Dojo.throws("unknown action throws", () => boardReducer(dojoB0, { type: "explode" } as any));
} catch (e) {
Dojo.check("reducer runs on frozen state without mutating it", false, String(e));
